title: Question egress test census

effect.user: The complete deploy test gate checks question serialization without repeating identical type-graph queries.
assertions: Exact complete raw census parity for unchanged production source.
Every existing injected serializer/result/error defect is independently rejected.
Cyclic positive and negative types remain correctly classified.
exclusions: Production request latency, idle-host timing baseline and process peak memory.

first-use.why: A fresh checker owns every baseline or patched census.

repeated.why: A fresh checker owns every baseline or patched census.

recipe.completion: Complete raw census written after traversal and existing coverage assertions.
recipe.warmup: None; each program is a separate cold logical checker.
recipe.teardown: No daemon or persistent fixture; retain capture.

budget.source: Predeclared work-subtraction target for this task; one complete walk per distinct immutable checker type.
